effects.effect: You create a 1-[aura](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/aura) vortex of slicing magic around you when you enter combat. An enemy that starts their [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to you takes [damage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage) equal to your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason).
